feature: Add Sentry Source Maps for Production Debugging
workflow_rationale: Adding new build-time tooling (@sentry/vite-plugin) to existing Sentry integration. This is a feature addition that requires package installation, build configuration changes, and environment setup.

subtasks.notes: Add @sentry/vite-plugin to devDependencies. Use npm install --save-dev @sentry/vite-plugin

phases.name: Vite Configuration
phases.description: Configure Sentry plugin in vite.config.ts with production-only conditional

verification.expected: Import statement for sentryVitePlugin should exist

subtasks.description: Add Sentry plugin to plugins array with production conditional

verification.command: cd apps/web && node -e "const config = require('./vite.config.ts'); process.exit(0)"
verification.expected: Vite config should have valid syntax

subtasks.notes: Add sentryVitePlugin to plugins array with: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && sentryVitePlugin({org: process.env.SENTRY_ORG, project: process.env.SENTRY_PROJECT, authToken: process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN}). Use .filter(Boolean) on plugins array.

subtasks.description: Enable sourcemap generation in build config

verification.expected: build config should include sourcemap: true

subtasks.notes: Add build: { sourcemap: true } to defineConfig if not already present

subtasks.description: Create or update .env.example with Sentry variables

verification.expected: .env.example should contain VITE_SENTRY_DSN, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG, SENTRY_PROJECT

subtasks.notes: Add documentation for: VITE_SENTRY_DSN (runtime), SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN (build-time), SENTRY_ORG (build-time), SENTRY_PROJECT (build-time). Include comments about where to obtain each value.

phases.name: Vercel Configuration
phases.description: Configure environment variables in Vercel dashboard (manual step)

subtasks.description: Document Vercel environment variable configuration steps

verification.instructions: Verify that VITE_SENTRY_DSN, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG, and SENTRY_PROJECT are added to Vercel production environment variables. SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN should be marked as sensitive.

subtasks.notes: MANUAL STEP: User must add environment variables to Vercel dashboard. Document the steps: 1) Go to Vercel project settings, 2) Navigate to Environment Variables, 3) Add all 4 Sentry variables for Production environment, 4) Mark SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN as sensitive.

phases.name: Build and Upload Verification
phases.description: Verify source map uploads work in production builds

verification.command: cd apps/web && NODE_ENV=production npm run build
verification.expected: Build should complete successfully and generate source maps in dist/

subtasks.notes: Run production build locally to verify: 1) Build completes without errors, 2) Source maps are generated (check dist/ for .map files), 3) Plugin only runs when NODE_ENV=production

subtasks.description: Verify Vercel deployment with source map upload

verification.instructions: Deploy to Vercel and verify: 1) Build logs show 'Uploading source maps to Sentry' message, 2) Sentry dashboard shows uploaded source maps under Releases, 3) Trigger test error and verify stack trace shows original file paths (e.g., App.tsx:42)

subtasks.notes: VERIFICATION STEP: After Vercel deployment, check build logs for source map upload confirmation, verify in Sentry dashboard, and test with a production error.

acceptance_criteria: vite.config.ts includes Sentry plugin with production conditional
Source maps uploaded to Sentry (verified in dashboard)
Production error stack traces show original source locations
Development builds do not attempt source map uploads
No security issues (auth token not exposed client-side)
Existing Sentry features (ErrorBoundary, Session Replay) still work

verification_steps.name: Build Test
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Build completes successfully with source maps generated

verification_steps.name: Secrets Scan
verification_steps.expected_outcome: No SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN found in source files or committed code

verification_steps.name: Production Error Test
verification_steps.command: Manual: Deploy to production, trigger test error, verify stack trace in Sentry
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Stack trace shows original TypeScript file paths (e.g., App.tsx:42)

verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk due to build process changes and secrets management. Integration testing required to verify builds succeed. Security scan needed for auth token handling. Staging deployment not required as source maps don't affect runtime behavior.

unit_tests.notes: No unit tests needed - configuration change only

integration_tests.notes: Verify build completes successfully with Sentry plugin

e2e_tests.notes: Manual verification in production after deployment

checks: No console errors related to Sentry

database_verification.notes: No database changes in this task

checks: vite.config.ts has production conditional for plugin
Production build generates .map files in dist/
Vercel build logs show source map upload (post-deployment)
SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN marked as sensitive in Vercel

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required due to dependencies

critical_notes: Phase 4 (Vercel configuration) is a MANUAL step requiring user action
Source map uploads only occur when NODE_ENV=production
SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN must NEVER be committed to git or exposed client-side
Verify existing Sentry features (ErrorBoundary, Session Replay) still work after changes
